title: 模拟测试
goal: 听后还原句子，并综合判断面试问题的功能和回答的适切性。
exam: TOEFL iBT（2026 年 1 月起的新版）· 口语

points.label: 判断问题的功能并选出合适的回答

sources.title: ETS：TOEFL iBT Test 2026 Update — Test Blueprint and Specifications
sources.used: 口语题型、题量、时间、话语功能和每题满分

sources.title: ETS：Updated TOEFL iBT Test Overview
sources.used: 口语任务说明、每题作答时间和面试评分标准

cards.title: 说明

body.p: 正式口语部分包括 Listen and Repeat 7 题与 Take an Interview 4 题，共 11 题，预计用时 8 分钟。两类题每题满分均为 5 分。
跟读要求原样复述听到的句子，每句的作答时限为 8–12 秒，随句子而定。面试在情境介绍后回答同一话题下的问题，每题作答 45 秒。
本课小测是开口前的客观题练习，题量和正式考试不同。开口说的部分，跟读到口语页的「跟读」练，面试到口语页的「对话」练。
还原句子要保留原来的词、顺序、时态和单复数。The forms are beside the printer. 不能说成 The form is behind the printer，两句的单复数和位置都不同。
面试题先判断问题要的是描述、解释、观点、建议、预测还是叙述，再看回答的内容。Why did the group move? 问的是原因，We moved because the old room was too small. 给出了原因。

cards.src: spec 第 6、17 页；overview 第 17、19 页

lines.text: The help desk is opposite the main staircase.

items.stem: Rebuild the sentence that was heard.
items.why: 录音是 is opposite the main staircase，beside 把位置改成了旁边。

lines.text: Please return the borrowed headphones to the media counter.

items.stem: Rebuild the sentence that was heard.
items.why: return … to 表示归还到柜台，from 会改变方向。

lines.text: The workshop opens at nine and closes before the evening lecture.

items.stem: Rebuild the sentence that was heard.
items.why: 录音有两个并列动作 opens 和 closes。before 表示讲座开始前关门，after 意思相反。

lines.text: If the weather changes, the outdoor activities will move into the sports hall.

items.stem: Rebuild the sentence that was heard.
items.why: If 引出条件，will move into 表示移进体育馆，out of 方向相反。

lines.text: Students who have completed the safety briefing can borrow equipment without a supervisor.

items.stem: Rebuild the sentence that was heard.
items.why: who have completed 修饰 Students。录音是 without a supervisor，with 意思相反。

lines.text: The detailed instructions for assembling the temporary display are available from the events coordinator.

items.stem: Rebuild the sentence that was heard.
items.why: 主语的中心词 instructions 是复数，所以用 are available。for assembling … 修饰 instructions。

lines.text: The student newspaper is considering an audio edition. What problems might it encounter during the first term?

items.stem: Which function does the question primarily request?
options: Recommending a final decision to cancel the edition
Narrating problems that have already occurred
Predicting difficulties the new edition may face
Describing the audio edition the newspaper is planning
items.why: might … encounter during the first term 问的是将来可能遇到的困难，所以是预测。considering 说明方案还在考虑中。

groups.text: Question: Why did the volunteer group switch from individual sign-ups to team sign-ups? Notes: individual volunteers often did not know anyone; teams gave new volunteers familiar partners; the form also changed color.

items.stem: Which opening answers the question using the relevant reason?
options: The new form was printed in a new color.
Newcomers could work with people they already knew.
Individual volunteers often knew many people in the group.
The team form was introduced after the individual form.
items.why: Why 问原因。teams gave new volunteers familiar partners 是原因，第二项是它的改写。表格换颜色与原因无关。

lines.text: The oral presentation group wants to help members who speak too quickly. What should the group do during practice?

items.stem: Which response offers a relevant suggestion?
options: It could ask members to pause between complete ideas.
Its members might speak faster when they feel nervous.
It met last term to prepare several short presentations.
Some members speak too quickly in presentations.
items.why: What should … do 问的是建议。第一项用 could 提出了具体做法。第二项是预测，不是建议。

groups.text: Question: What was learned from organizing the neighborhood clean-up? Response: We organized a clean-up. The clean-up was a neighborhood activity. It was an activity that we organized.

items.stem: What is the main problem supported by the transcript?
options: It gives a specific lesson that is unrelated to the neighborhood.
It describes the clean-up in too much specific detail.
It supports a lesson with too many different examples.
It repeats the activity without explaining any learning.
items.why: 三句都在重复 organized、clean-up 和 activity，没有回答 What was learned。

groups.text: Question: Describe a time when a group plan failed and explain the response. Notes: the planned room became unavailable; the group found another room; it informed participants of the new location.

items.stem: Which answer preserves the event and the response?
options: We found another room, so the first one became unavailable.
Our room became unavailable, so we moved and told participants.
The room stayed available, but we canceled without notifying anyone.
We told participants to use the old room after moving to the new one.
items.why: became unavailable 是问题，found another room 和 informed participants 是应对。第一项把因果说反了。

groups.text: Question: Would a student-run equipment library be useful? Notes: occasional users could borrow rather than buy; maintenance would still cost money; students would manage the loans.

items.stem: Which answer gives a supported position while retaining the limitation?
options: It would be free to maintain because students would manage loans.
It would force occasional users to buy all the equipment.
It could reduce purchases, though maintenance would still need funding.
It could eliminate all costs for every user and for the student managers.
items.why: borrow rather than buy 支持减少购买。maintenance would still cost money 是限制，第三项把它保留了下来。
